description: This file is a C source code file implementing blame functionality in a version control system, likely part of Git, dealing with commit analysis, blame and diff computations, fingerprinting, and line matching logic.

classes.name: struct blame_origin
classes.description: Represents the origin of blame for a particular line or file in a commit.

classes.name: struct fingerprint
classes.description: Represents the fingerprint used for line similarity assessment.

classes.name: struct fingerprint_entry
classes.description: An individual entry in a fingerprint's multiset, counts the occurrence of a byte pair.

classes.name: struct blame_entry
classes.description: Represents a segment of lines in blame analysis, including suspect origin, line numbers, and linkage information.

classes.name: struct blame_scoreboard
classes.description: Holds data for the overall blame computation, including references to commits, blobs, and other metadata.

classes.name: struct blame_list
classes.description: Associates blame entries with their respective split information for processing.
